e.title: actuarial-reserving (Python)
e.summary: Python P&C 损失准备金库（pip 可装）：链梯/BF/Cape Cod + 自助置信区间
e.body: actuarial-reserving（dyjang83/reserving）是开源的 Python P&C 损失准备金库（pip install actuarial-reserving）：链梯法、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Cape Cod 方法，附自助法置信区间。对 RIAA：Python 侧的准备金计算库（与 [[chainladder-python]]（CAS 官方）、[[trikit]] 互补——三选一按需求）。与 [[claims-reserving-benchmark]]（方法对比）、[[reserving-ml]]（教学实现）相关。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Python 库 actuarial-reserving（pip），链梯/BF/Cape Cod+自助 CI
e.summary_en: Open-source Python P&C loss-reserve library (pip-installable): chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, Cape Cod with bootstrap confidence intervals
e.summary_hk: Python P&C 損失準備金庫（pip 可裝）：鏈梯/BF/Cape Cod + 自助置信區間
e.body_en: actuarial-reserving (dyjang83/reserving) is an open-source Python P&C loss-reserve library (pip install actuarial-reserving): chain-ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson and Cape Cod methods with bootstrap confidence intervals. For RIAA: the Python-side reserving calculation library (complementing [[chainladder-python]] (CAS official) and [[trikit]] — pick per need). Related to [[claims-reserving-benchmark]] (method comparison) and [[reserving-ml]] (teaching implementation). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: actuarial-reserving（dyjang83/reserving）是開源的 Python P&C 損失準備金庫（pip install actuarial-reserving）：鏈梯法、Bornhuetter-Ferguson、Cape Cod 方法，附自助法置信區間。對 RIAA：Python 側的準備金計算庫（與 [[chainladder-python]]（CAS 官方）、[[trikit]] 互補——三選一按需求）。與 [[claims-reserving-benchmark]]（方法對比）、[[reserving-ml]]（教學實現）相關。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
